style: Painterly cinematic 3D-animated adventure film, same look and same characters as the reference image: chunky chibi Lil Blunt (green creature, big round eyes, spiky green leaf crest, brown cowboy hat with aviator goggles, red bandana), dynamic trailer-style camera, warm saturated golden light, rich amber colour grade. Silent film: absolutely no music, no score, no singing.

shots.prompt: The camera chases the wooden mine cart down the three rails out of the mine mouth; Lil Blunt grips the rim, stares ahead as the rails end at a dead end, his eyes go wide, the cart hits the broken rail end and launches into the air in a slow-motion arc over the gap.

Lil Blunt flies over the gap in the cart, panicking, the cart tumbles away, he spins through the air and slams his head hard on a big tree stump, stars circle above him, he lies knocked out, dust settling, golden hour light.

Inferno Bull gently dabs the whiskey-soaked cloth on the bump on Lil Blunt's forehead; Lil Blunt winces and groans and slowly opens one eye, steam and embers drifting, molten gold glowing behind them.

Inferno Bull, seated, introduces himself with a proud gruff gesture, lifts the Winchester rifle and the glowing miner helmet toward Lil Blunt; Lil Blunt grins, hands over a small golden bitcoin coin, takes the helmet and puts it on, then grabs the rifle with a big happy bounce. Cigar smoke curls.
Inferno Bull stands behind Lil Blunt guiding the Winchester toward the targets; Lil Blunt fires, bright muzzle flash and a target is hit, Bull nods proudly and points ahead.
